title: Sprint 4B: Sign in with Aadi Identity
bullets: Academic is now a product on the Aadi multitenant platform
No separate password: one account, many companies, many products
narration: Sprint four B. Sign in through Aadi Identity. The Academic application is now a product on the same multitenant platform as Project Tracker, so people use one account and no separate password.

title: How sign in works
bullets: The sign in token is verified: signature, issuer, audience, expiry, nonce
The company comes from the token and scopes every query
The session is a signed, secure cookie
narration: The standard authorization code flow with PKCE is used. The returned token is verified for its signature, issuer, audience, expiry and nonce. The company in the token scopes every query, and the session is a signed secure cookie.

title: Roles inside the product
bullets: The first person of a company becomes its admin
Everyone else is read only until an admin grants a role
Roles: admin, content operator, reviewer, production operator
Admins cannot remove their own admin role
narration: Identity decides who may sign in. Roles live inside the product. The first person of a company becomes its admin. Everyone else is read only, until an admin grants a role.

title: Production registration
bullets: Product academics and client academics web registered in Identity
Rehearsed on the demo stack first
A wrong return address is refused
Each company still needs an Academic subscription in Identity
narration: The product and its client were registered in production Identity, after a rehearsal on the demo stack. A wrong return address is refused. Each company still needs an Academic subscription, which a platform admin adds in Identity.

title: Test results
bullets: Covers forged state, wrong audience, wrong issuer, expired and unsigned tokens
Covers tenant isolation and role checks
narration: Twenty seven backend tests pass. They cover forged state, wrong audience or issuer, expired tokens, tokens signed with an unknown key, tenant isolation, and role checks. Next is sprint five, import and review.
